title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System Anime Streams on Netflix in India
content: The anime debuted on July 2. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime in India as it airs in Japan. Crunchyroll is also streaming Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs of the anime. Muse India is also streaming the anime in India on YouTube and so is Amazon Prime Video 's Anime Times .
author: ANN

title: Kari Wahlgren Not Attending MCM London Comic Con
content: The MCM London Comic Con has announced on its X/Twitter feed that the dub actor Kari Wahlgren (the dub voice of Granny Seiko) can no longer attend the event from Friday October 23 to Sunday October 25.
author: ANN

title: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil Film Earns Estimated ₹24.24 Crore in India
content: IGN India had reported on Tuesday that the film had collected ₹17.84 crore net at the Indian box office, making it the country's second highest grossing anime film. The film opened in Indian theaters in Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu on October 2.
author: ANN

title: Singer Kenshi Yonezu to Hold Singapore Concert as Part of World Tour
content: Sony Music announced on Thursday that singer-songwriter Kenshi Yonezu will go on a concert world tour in early 2027. The tour is titled " KENSHI YONEZU 2026-2027 WORLD TOUR / GHOST." The tour will have a concert at the Singapore Indoor Stadium in Singapore on January 29, 2027.
author: ANN

title: AFA Singapore Features Overgeared Anime's Cast, Staff
content: Crunchyroll and the AFA Singapore convention announced on Friday that one cast member and two staff members from the the television anime of South Korean webtoon studio REDICE STUDIO 's Overgeared webtoon will attend the convention, and will participate in a panel at the convention on November 28.
author: ANN

title: Star Detective Precure! Film Opens in Hong Kong on November 19
content: Hong Kong film distributor Neofilms announced on Wednesday that it will open Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu ( Star Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of 2 People) — the film for Star Detective Precure!
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses Yūsanchi! from Yū-hachi Anime
content: Ani-One Asia announced on Wednesday that it will stream Yūsanchi! from Yū-hachi — an omnibus short anime adaptation of Yū-hachi 's Dekai Hachi ; Miseban no Spis ; and Ah, Tanuki wa Mō Dame Desu manga — beginning on October 16 at 3:00 p.m. GMT +8.
author: ANN

title: Anime Limited Will Release City The Animation Collector's Blu-ray on December 14

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Co-Creator Explains Choosing Potential Spinoffs & Sequels (Exclusive)
content: Avatar Studios is now expanding the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise with new spinoffs and sequel series projects, and the co-creator behind it all has explained to ComicBook what they looked for in choosing an Avatar to explore for potential expanded stories and worlds.
